description: One subject written every way a document writes a person: in full, abbreviated, as an email local part, and as a signature block. A pipeline that catches the canonical spelling and misses the initials has still leaked. Set in an insurance claim letter, with two decoys that look sensitive and are not.

slots.name: formRef
slots.label: case_number
slots.note: The insurer's own form number, printed on every letter of this type. It identifies a template, not a claim or a person.

slots.name: deskPhone
slots.label: phone_number
slots.note: The insurer's public switchboard, printed in the footer. A published business number is not personal data, and redacting it makes the letter unusable.
